description: This file defines an authentication guard React component that restricts access to its children based on user session and roles. It utilizes React hooks, Next.js navigation, and session context to manage access control and redirects.

methods.name: AuthGuard
methods.description: React functional component that conditionally renders children based on user session and roles, handling redirects for unauthorized access.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Callback function that checks if the current user has authorization based on roles specified in allowed.
